name: origin-computer-use
description: Computer Use workflow for controlling and visually verifying OriginLab Origin on Windows.

interface.shortDescription: Control OriginLab Origin through Codex Computer Use with screenshot verification.
interface.longDescription: A local workflow plugin for OriginLab Origin desktop automation. It complements originpro and PowerPoint OLE workflows by handling UI-level inspection, window selection, and screenshot-based verification through Codex Computer Use.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Origin Computer Use to inspect Origin readiness and control Origin only after the Computer Use preflight passes.
